Aldrin is a persistent organic pollutant that was used as an insecticide. It has been banned in many countries due to its environmental persistence and health risks.

The Joint FAO/WHO Meeting on Pesticide Residues (JMPR) has established an ADI for aldrin (combined with dieldrin, as they are closely related compounds) of 0.0001 mg/kg body weight per day.
